diff --git a/test/test_repair_file_operations.py b/test/test_repair_file_operations.py
new file mode 100644
--- /dev/null
+++ b/test/test_repair_file_operations.py
@@ -0,0 +1,50 @@
+import os
+import shutil
+import tempfile
+import unittest
+
+from luigi.file import LocalFileSystem
+from luigi.mock import MockFileSystem, MockTarget
+
+
+class LocalRenameTest(unittest.TestCase):
+    def test_filesystem_rename_moves_file_contents(self):
+        directory = tempfile.mkdtemp(prefix='luigi-rename-')
+        try:
+            source = os.path.join(directory, 'source.txt')
+            destination = os.path.join(directory, 'renamed.txt')
+            payload = b'first line\nsecond line\n'
+            with open(source, 'wb') as stream:
+                stream.write(payload)
+
+            LocalFileSystem().rename(source, destination)
+
+            self.assertFalse(os.path.exists(source))
+            self.assertTrue(os.path.exists(destination))
+            with open(destination, 'rb') as stream:
+                self.assertEqual(stream.read(), payload)
+        finally:
+            shutil.rmtree(directory)
+
+
+class MockMoveTest(unittest.TestCase):
+    def setUp(self):
+        self.fs = MockFileSystem()
+        self.fs.clear()
+
+    def tearDown(self):
+        self.fs.clear()
+
+    def test_target_move_moves_file_contents(self):
+        source = MockTarget('/repair/source.txt')
+        destination = MockTarget('/repair/moved.txt')
+        payload = 'first line\nsecond line\n'
+        with source.open('w') as stream:
+            stream.write(payload)
+
+        source.move(destination.path)
+
+        self.assertFalse(MockTarget('/repair/source.txt').exists())
+        self.assertTrue(destination.exists())
+        with destination.open('r') as stream:
+            self.assertEqual(stream.read(), payload)

bash /testbed/mimo_test_command.sh

/root/.venv-luigi/bin/python -m pytest test/test_repair_file_operations.py -q

if [ "$REPAIR_NEW_RC" -ne 0 ]; then exit 1; fi
exit "$REPAIR_RC"
